authorization.scope: Repair, test and deploy J387 on named project. Enable affiliate per validated provider/SKU when identity equality AND actual provider attribution verification pass. Approval does not create missing product photos, vouchers or price history.

baseline.note: J386 UI and API improvements may be salvaged after correction; never restore deleted M2 code.

tasks: Create one authoritative versioned record for each of 30 products. Generate UI cards, product map, worker catalogue and outbound links from it; remove parallel hand-maintained arrays.
Record immutable itemId, provider, merchant ID/Mall evidence, product ID, variant ID, canonical URL, actual attributed URL, price/observed_at, raw evidence path+hash and media source/rights/hash.

Build must fail on any missing, extra, duplicate or mismatched ID, merchant, variant, canonical/attributed URL, price or asset binding across generated outputs. Compare all records by ID, never zip by array position.

Include deliberate mutation fixtures for ID, URL, variant, price and swapped media mapping; each must fail build. Byte/hash equality alone does not prove a photographed object matches the SKU: visually inspect each of 30.

Acquire real official merchant photos for all 30. No stock illustration, unrelated image or evidence-error screenshot. Preserve original source and legitimate rights basis; report pending photos accurately.
30-day low and savings percentage require authentic dated coverage with matching variant/conditions and named reference price. If absent, show observed price/date; never backfill synthetic history.

Validate JayT provider authentication and exact attributed destination with redacted provider response and capture time. A configured partner ID or URL-shaped string is insufficient. Enable affiliate for passing providers immediately, report ready counts and unresolved ones.

Acquire at least 15 current locally applicable high-value F&B/cinema offers. Targets include Katinat zero-price/gift, Phe La BOGO, Highlands 30K lunch reduction, Metiz U22 55K, Galaxy Tuesday 50K. Treat these as requested acquisition targets until official current evidence confirms them.
Record official detail URL, raw snapshot/screenshot and extracted terms hash, effective dates, Da Nang branch applicability, eligibility, caps and redemption.

Render one concise sourced tip, then 'Chép Mã Bí Mật' only for an actual publicly supplied usable code and 'Mở App Áp Mã' only for a verified app redemption route. Counter/member/no-code offers remain visible with matching condition/open-offer CTA.
Never call a public offer secret in a way that invents exclusive access; no manufactured codes, free-price labels for paid conditions, or expired promotions presented as active.
Pin 4 campus clusters below Hero: Bách Khoa / Sư Phạm; Kinh Tế DUE; Duy Tân / Hải Châu; Sơn Trà.

One tap applies food <=35000 VND and <=1km from documented campus anchors; coffee power-outlet filter requires venue evidence. Unknown coordinates/amenities must not be inferred. Label straight-line distance.

3 visible columns ShopeeFood, GrabFood, Xanh SM; accessible 25000–150000 VND slider, integer totals and editable delivery/fees/discount eligibility. Highlight cheapest of comparable actual inputs with Emerald plus text.
Measure input-to-render p50/p95/max against <30ms target on declared environment. Include boundaries, ties, empty results, keyboard and reduced motion.
Put 'Lập Kèo Rủ Bạn (Zalo Pass)' directly on every eligible food/cinema card.
Use explicit participant count and accurate total to allocate integer VND with conserved sum; generate sharp local Canvas PNG with offer name, basis, allocation and canonical link.
Verify decoded downloaded PNG, cross-origin image safety, download/native-share/text fallback. Sharing requires user gesture; do not send messages automatically.
Retain itemId-only public status contract. Reject ALL unknown fields, require own-property catalogue membership, and validate URL/hostname/HTTPS/port against generated audited records.
Authenticated worker alone triggers outbound probes; public read returns stored observation. Add rate limits/concurrency/time bounds. CORS is not authentication.
Use canonical IP parsing with IPv4/IPv6 reserved/private rejection and pinned connection. Test mixed DNS, mapped/expanded IPv6, redirects and no outbound calls on rejected inputs.
3xx and missing/stale observations must be UNKNOWN, never STORED_AVAILABLE with a fabricated checked_at. HTTP200 proves reachability only, not inventory.
Keep durable SLA explicitly unasserted until scheduled shared persistence is operational and measured.

delivery_strategy: Ship coherent verified UI/security improvements as an incremental release while source acquisition continues. Report remaining targets explicitly. Prefer a focused correction or disabling the faulty action over whole-site rollback for noncritical issues; rollback is reserved for active critical security/startup/payment/data corruption that cannot be contained promptly.
acceptance: Build equality and adversarial security checks pass.
30 real-image SKU target and 15 verified-deal target reported with exact achieved counts; unmet targets remain open.
1440/768/390 image correctness, no blank/error cards or overflow, keyboard/CTA/PNG tests and measured interaction latency.
Resolve alias, bind served asset hashes, check HTTP200 / /registry.json /deals_feed.json and safe API behavior.
Actual Gemini phone review binds deployment and reviewed artifacts; executor must not impersonate reviewer or manufacture PASS.

reporting.ack: Record real executor ACK/start and 3-hour M0 due time; ISSUED is not proof of delivery.
reporting.progress: Submit M0 result with exact mismatch/photo/provider counts within 3 hours. Continue independent modules while acquisition is pending.
reporting.deadline: 22:00 11/09/2026 local; record actual timestamps and explain missed deadlines without backdating.
reporting.completion: No self-awarded Gemini attestation, invented 30-day histories or verified-provider claims. Do not close J387 while target work remains.
